# HoshiDicts Native Host Performance

## Scope

The Goal 2 benchmark uses the deterministic public fixture generated by
`scripts/generate_hoshidicts_fixture.py` and the pinned MIT HoshiDicts commit
`81e293cde156751e7f38cb040c86eb2c644ee4d2`.

The fixture is intentionally small and redistributable. These measurements are
the regression baseline for the host/protocol boundary, not a claim about every
user dictionary. Goal 13 must repeat the benchmark with the release fixture set
before stable release.

## Method

- Process handshake: 20 fresh native processes launched through
  `GSM_Overlay/hoshidicts_client.js`.
- Protocol handshake: 200 in-process parse/dispatch/serialize cycles.
- Catalog activation: 50 replacement catalogs using the imported fixture.
- Warm lookup: one warmup followed by 500 inflected `食べました` lookups.
- Memory: resident bytes after catalog activation and lookup.
- Build: CMake `Release`.

Run locally with:

```sh
ctest --test-dir build/hoshidicts-provenance \
  --label-regex performance --verbose
```

The `HoshiDicts Provenance` workflow runs the same benchmark on Windows x64,
Linux x64, and macOS arm64. It uploads the full CTest log as a
`hoshidicts-performance-<OS>-<architecture>` artifact.

## Initial Linux Baseline

Recorded on 2026-08-04 with GCC 14.2.1:

| Metric | Result | Budget |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Process handshake p95 | 2.2 ms | 500 ms |
| Protocol handshake p95 | 0.001 ms | diagnostic |
| Catalog activation p95 | 0.4 ms | 2,000 ms |
| Warm lookup p50 | 0.2 ms | 30 ms |
| Warm lookup p95 | 0.3 ms | 100 ms |
| Resident memory | 10 MiB | 1.5 GiB |

CI artifacts are authoritative for platform comparisons. A platform-specific
fixture regression above 20% requires investigation even when it remains below
the absolute guard.
